name: Self-order mobile checkout screen
describe: Checkout: header ("← Back to cart", "Checkout"), Order Summary card with item rows and total, Payment Method card (Pay Online / Pay at Counter selected / Request Bill; selected = border-primary bg-primary/10) and a full-width "Place Order" button.
Final step before the order is sent. RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels.
